label: nyiso 41 hub prices
definition: nyiso-41 takes the nyiso-40 measured-gas fidelity fixes (true-dated Transco Z6 NY daily quotes; monthly hub levels recomputed from the completed daily series) and adds one structural mechanism: nyiso_import_hub_prices reprices the priced import node's PJM_west / ISONE_tie tranches at the measured hourly PJM / ISO-NE Day-Ahead system LMP plus the $1 inter-control-area wheeling hurdle, replacing keeper-39's static per-year IMPORT_TRANCHES_BY_YEAR ladder (a backcast fit re-fitted per year, blind to neighbor fundamentals) with a measured neighbor price-formation input read blind to NYISO's own flow. Every price criterion moves toward actual with no tuned constant — C3a mean LMP -15.6/-19.2/-13.2% -> -13.3/-13.4/-9.5%, C3b NRMSE 0.211/0.304/0.203 -> 0.209/0.236/0.172, C3c price-tail hours 0h -> 7h in 2025 (the first NYISO model tail hours ever) — while C1/C2/C4/C6 hold PASS. Determination: NOT-YET (deciding criterion: caveat budget exceeded, hard 0/1, soft 4/2 — C3a/C3b/C3c price caveats plus a C5a CO2 caveat exceed the 2-soft-caveat budget); promoted as the newest, most structurally faithful NYISO run, replacing nyiso-39.
